    From TinyAt in the ray category to the algebra (bridge) #

    For a split basic distributive algebra B with ray category P = BGRSRayCategory (projective category), a TinyAt point of P gives the data of not_minimal_of_tiny, so a minimal representation-infinite B has no such point. Morphisms i ⟶ j of the projective category are elements of e_j B e_i, composed in reverse order.

    This file: the basic dictionary — a morphism has a non-invertible ray iff it lies in the radical of B.
